questions.prompt: Which document limited the power of the English monarchy in 1689?
questions.fact: It followed the deposition of one king and heavily influenced the American document of the same name a century later.

questions.prompt: Which planet's day is about 24 hours 37 minutes?
questions.fact: Mission teams working on its surface operate on that clock, drifting steadily out of step with Earth time.

questions.prompt: Which country won the most medals at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics?
questions.fact: China led the gold medal count for much of the Games before being overtaken on the final day.

questions.prompt: Which 1976 film follows a Philadelphia club boxer handed a world title shot?
questions.fact: Its star wrote the script in a few days and refused to sell it unless he could play the lead.

questions.prompt: Which desert lies along the coast of Namibia?
questions.fact: It is probably the oldest desert on Earth, arid for at least fifty-five million years.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Sirius Black?
options: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
questions.fact: The dog star of the same name is the brightest in the night sky, which is a deliberate pun on his form.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Jenkins automation server?
options: An open source community after a fork
questions.fact: It was forked from a project called Hudson after a dispute with Oracle over trademark control.
